analyst_notes: Selected the official SLMPD monthly NIBRS CSV files because they expose IncidentDate, IncidentNum, NIBRS/NIBRSCategory, direct Latitude/Longitude, and all seven Part-I offense families for 2024. NIBRS mapping follows the project FBI guide: 09A murder; 11A/11B/11C rape; 120 robbery; 13A aggravated assault; 220 burglary; 23A-23H larceny; 240 motor vehicle theft. The public monthly files re-emit supplemented incidents; a VictimNum-inclusive identity was audited and rejected after producing >30% overcounts on multiple offenses. The stable public identity is IncidentNum plus NIBRS/offense/location/coordinates. Incident rows are admitted as share-only; annual totals stay in the official control lane unless the strict 10% reconciliation gate clears.
